name: Check the session handshake
rationale:
The connection handshake in tasks/session.lua: requests start on connect, wait while
armed, resume after disarm, retry after genuine failures, survive queue pressure, and
nothing after API_VERSION is requested for unsupported firmware. It was not a CI job,
so its fixture fell behind session.lua (battery profile index, flight timer, main power,
flight records, live sensors, the API-version gate); pure modules now load for real and
the rest are inert stubs.
